rootCause: The MKMAP ABI-selected icedpool member was absent from shared metadata. A C header alias to rm.flags was only represented in some record-view paths. Original TU fixtures used C helpers and real generation checks omitted ICE, so neither exercised the production setter.

originalCProductionIceRegression.limits: Component generation on source-initialized real C/JS worlds; all map bytes, world graph and complete ordered main/display RNG logs compared. Does not identify the unavailable leaderboard recording.

ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.
